purpose: Software twin / simulation scaffold for CELL_V1, seven-cell flower, and recursive scaling.

levels.label: Single simulated cell
levels.target: Test local ternary choice, hysteresis, mirrored Field/Void state, and bounded reinjection/bus abstractions.

levels.label: Seven-cell flower
levels.target: Test center-plus-six coordination, local autonomy, shared reference/bus behavior, and distributed hysteresis.

levels.label: Connected flower lattice
levels.target: Test whether useful routes emerge across linked flowers without path popularity becoming authority.

levels.label: Recursive body-scale graph
levels.target: Test scaling, local-vs-global control, compression upward, action downward, and failure isolation.

rules: Simulation is not proof of hardware or physics.
Nodes/ remains OWATCH canon and read-only from this sandbox.
Each scale must preserve the lower-scale contracts instead of replacing them.
Path hysteresis is routing memory, not truth.
A larger scale may compress lower-scale state but must retain a traceable reference path.
Hardware-specific quantities are placeholders until tied to measured build data.
